# Awesome AECO

> A curated list of open-source tools, libraries, file formats and websites for Architecture, Engineering, Construction and Operations (AECO): BIM and IFC, CAD, Revit plugins, simulation and analysis, parametric and computational design, IoT and smart buildings, facility and asset management, generative design, construction robotics, digital twins, GIS, project management, and cost estimation. Each entry has a name, a one-sentence description and a link to its GitHub repository or website. Released under CC0.

## The list

- [readme.md (raw Markdown)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/main/readme.md): The complete list in plain Markdown. Entries are grouped under `##` category headings; each entry is a bold name, a description line and an italic `GitHub:` or `Website:` link line.
- [catalog.json (enriched JSON)](https://awesome-aeco.org/data/catalog.json): Machine-readable JSON catalog of all entries enriched weekly with GitHub stars, star velocity, license, primary language, topics, and inferred domain/standard tags (CC BY 4.0).
- [Awesome AECO Directory (web)](https://awesome-aeco.org/awesome/): Searchable, filterable web directory backed by `readme.md` and `catalog.json`.
- [Awesome AECO Hub (web)](https://awesome-aeco.org/): Brand hub, weekly movers digest, AI/developer docs, and brand kit.
- [MCP Server (remote HTTP)](https://mcp.awesome-aeco.org/mcp): Hosted stateless Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol server wrapping `catalog.json` (tools: `search_tools`, `check_before_building`, `draft_submission`, `get_tool`, `list_categories`, `list_tags`, `get_movers`; prompts: `find-or-build-aeco-tool`, `add-after-you-build`; skill resources: `awesome-aeco://skills/awesome-aeco`, `awesome-aeco://skills/add-after-you-build`). Also available via stdio (`npx -y awesome-aeco-mcp`, [awesome-aeco/awesome-aeco-mcp](https://github.com/awesome-aeco/awesome-aeco-mcp)) and pre-configured in [`.mcp.json`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/main/.mcp.json).

## Contributing

- [Suggest a resource (Issue Form)](https://github.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/issues/new?template=suggest-resource.yml): Zero-friction form that validates links and automatically opens a pull request.
- [Request a missing AECO tool (Wanted Form)](https://github.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/issues/new?template=wanted-tool.yml): Log unmet AECO tool gaps discovered during `check_before_building` so the community knows what needs to be built.
- [Agent Skill (`skills/awesome-aeco/SKILL.md`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/main/skills/awesome-aeco/SKILL.md): Installable skill (`npx skills add awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO`) instructing AI coding agents to check Awesome AECO before building from scratch and to help authors list new AECO tools.
- [Agent Skill (`skills/add-after-you-build/SKILL.md`)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/main/skills/add-after-you-build/SKILL.md): Dedicated release-time skill that inspects a newly built AECO repository, checks for duplicates, and generates a pre-filled Awesome AECO submission form or pull request.
- [Contribution guidelines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/main/contributing.md): Inclusion criteria and the exact entry format.
- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/main/AGENTS.md): Rules and checklists for AI agents proposing changes.
- [Add-entry prompt template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/main/prompts/add-entry.md): A ready-made prompt for an AI agent to verify a resource and open a pull request that adds it to the list.
- [Brand kit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/main/brand/README.md): Logos, color tokens, OpenGraph card, and embeddable badges.
- [Featured badge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/main/badges/featured-in-awesome-aeco.svg): SVG badge that listed projects can add to their README; snippet in the contribution guidelines.

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO): Source, issues and pull requests.
- [License (CC0 1.0)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/main/LICENSE): Public-domain dedication for the curated list content.
- [Trademark & Brand Policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/awesome-aeco/Awesome-AECO/main/TRADEMARK.md): Usage terms for the Awesome AECO name, logos, and badges.
